lines.text: What actually happens inside your skull when you pull an all-nighter for twenty-four hours?
By hour sixteen, your brain's prefrontal cortex begins to power down non-essential functions.
After twenty-four hours awake, your cognitive impairment equals a blood alcohol level of zero point one percent.
Toxic cellular metabolic waste like beta-amyloid builds up between your brain cells.
Your reaction times slow to a crawl, and your amygdala causes intense emotional mood swings.
Your brain will even force micro-sleeps, shutting off your conscious awareness for several seconds without warning.
Never drive while sleep deprived; getting a solid seven hours is essential for your brain.
